footer.tagline: Tsarin sarrafawa na AI da ke gudanar da kasuwancinka kuma yana sayarwa a madadinka. An gina shi don yadda kasuwancin Afirka ke aiki da gaske.
footer.trialLine: Gwaji kyauta na kwana 14 tare da cikakken shiga · sannan ka biya kawai abin da kake amfani da shi.
home.hero.badge: Tsarin sarrafawa na AI don kasuwanci
home.hero.title: Gudanar da dukkan kasuwancinka — kuma bar Kuza ta sayar a madadinka, duk inda kake sayarwa.
home.hero.subtitle: Kuza tana riƙe kowane reshe kan tushen gaskiya guda ɗaya — stok, tallace-tallace, fatura, littattafai, albashi — yayin da wakilan AI ke amsa wa abokan cinikinka a WhatsApp da Instagram tare da mai da tattaunawa zuwa oda da littattafanka suka riga suka fahimta.
home.hero.trust2: Babu katin da ake buƙata don farawa
home.channels.heading: Dandali guda ɗaya, duk inda abokan cinikinka suke
home.ripple.title: Sayarwa guda tana sabunta komai. A ma'amala guda ɗaya.
home.ripple.body: Ko an ƙidaya shi a kanti ko wakili ya kammala shi a saƙon sirri, sayarwa tana yaɗuwa cikin dukkan aikinka a lokacin da ta faru — don haka littattafanka ba za su taɓa ɓata daga stok ɗinka ba.
home.ripple.step1.title: An ware stok
home.ripple.step1.body: FIFO, LIFO ko FEFO — ƙa'idarka. Kaya ya ƙare a wannan reshe? Kuza tana koma zuwa na gaba.
home.ripple.step2.title: An bi diddigin batch
home.ripple.step2.body: Kowane layi yana tuna daga wane batch da mai kaya ya fito, kuma a kan wane farashi.
home.ripple.step3.title: An ƙara a littafi
home.ripple.step3.body: Layi guda da ba ya canzawa ga kowace motsi, an rubuta a cikin ma'amala ɗaya da sayarwar.
home.ripple.step4.title: An shigar da littattafai
home.ripple.step4.body: Kuɗin shiga, haraji, farashin kaya — shigar sau biyu tana rubuta kanta.
home.ripple.step5.title: An sabunta dashboard
home.ripple.step5.body: Masu mallaka suna gani nan take. Babu abin da za a sake shigarwa, babu abin da za a daidaita a ƙarshen wata.
home.feature.selling.title: Sayar da kaya duk inda abokan cinikinka suke
home.feature.selling.body: Wakilin AI ɗinka yana tattaunawa a WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger da Telegram — yana ba da farashin stok kai tsaye, yana karɓar oda kuma yana duba biyan kuɗi bisa ƙa'idojinka. Kanti, tebur, famfo da kasuwa duk suna gudana zuwa wuri guda.
home.feature.selling.point2: Saƙon sirri yana zama oda na gaske — an shigar da shi cikin littafinka
home.feature.branches.title: Kowane reshe. Gaskiya guda.
home.feature.branches.body: Stok, farashi da kuɗaɗen shiga na kowane reshe — tare da shiga da ke bin ƙungiyarka, ba akasin haka ba. Ma'aikata suna ganin rassansu kawai, manaja suna amincewa da abin da ya iso, masu mallaka suna ganin komai, ko'ina.
home.feature.branches.point1: Canja wuri tsakanin rassa tare da matakin karɓa na manaja — stok ba ya ɓacewa a hanya
home.feature.branches.point2: Kaya ya ƙare? Sayarwa tana koma zuwa reshe na gaba kai tsaye
home.feature.accounting.title: Littattafan da ke rubuta kansu.
home.feature.accounting.body: Kowace sayarwa, karɓar kaya, fatura, biyan abokin ciniki da gudanar da albashi tana shigar da nata shigar da ta daidaita — kai tsaye, a cikin ma'amala guda. Ma'auni, riba da hasara, ma'aunin kuɗi da babban littafi, a shirye duk lokacin da kake shirye.
home.feature.accounting.point2: Littattafan da ba za su taɓa ɓata daga stok ɗinka ba
home.feature.copilot.title: Tambayi kasuwancinka komai.
home.feature.copilot.body: Kuza Copilot yana amsawa daga bayananka — tallace-tallace, stok, albashi, littattafai — a duk rassa ko ɗaya kawai. Ana ƙididdige lambobi a cikin lambar shirye-shirye; AI kawai yana bayyana su. Ba zai taɓa ƙirƙira lamba ba.
home.feature.copilot.point1: Amsoshin da suka dogara kan bayananka na gaske
home.feature.copilot.point2: Gabaɗaya ko na reshe, cikin harshe mai sauƙi

home.modules.title: Duk abin da kasuwanci na gaske ke gudana a kai — a app guda.
home.modules.body: Zaɓi sana'ar da ta dace da yadda kake sayarwa, sannan ka ƙara sassan da aka raba waɗanda aikinka ke buƙata. Babu haɗin da za a saka — sun riga sun raba tushen stok guda da babban littafi guda.
home.modules.inventory.title: Kaya
home.modules.inventory.desc: Batch, canja wuri, ƙima da sake yin oda a duk rassa.
home.modules.restaurant.title: Gidan cin abinci
home.modules.restaurant.desc: Oda, POS, tebur, ɗakin studio na menu da menu na QR kyauta.
home.modules.invoicing.title: Yin fatura
home.modules.invoicing.desc: Fatura mai alamar kasuwancinka da basussuka da ke daidaitawa da biyan kuɗi.
home.modules.accounting.title: Lissafin kuɗi
home.modules.accounting.desc: Littattafan shigar sau biyu da ke rubuta kansu daga ayyuka.
home.modules.people.title: Ma'aikata & Albashi
home.modules.people.desc: Ma'aikata, halarta, hutu da albashi tare da haraji — an shigar da su cikin littattafanka.
home.modules.payments.title: Biyan kuɗi
home.modules.payments.desc: Canja wurin banki & asusun kama-da-wane, ana daidaitawa kai tsaye. Kati & kuɗin waya suna cikin shirin gaba.
home.modules.footnote.pre: Kuza AI da Kasuwar masu kaya suna cikin kowane shiri — ba a sayar da su daban ba.
home.industries.title: An sanya masa tufa don sana'ar da yake gudanarwa.
home.industries.body: Gidajen cin abinci, kanti, jumla, ayyuka, man fetur da masana'antu — kowanne yana da nasa yanayin da takamaiman ayyukan da Kuza ke yi masa, ba magana ta gabaɗaya ba.
home.marketplace.title: Sake cika kaya daga masu kaya ba tare da barin littattafanka ba.
home.marketplace.body: Nemi masu kaya a hanyar sadarwar Kuza, ka yi oda na saye, kuma ka kalli yadda yake shiga stok ɗinka da fatura tasu — bangarorin biyu suna daidaituwa kai tsaye. Ka biya nan take daga jakar kuɗin Kuza ko ka tabbatar da canja wurin banki.
home.marketplace.point1: Oda na saye guda yana sabunta kasuwanci biyu — naka da na mai kayanka.
home.marketplace.point2: Canja wurin jakar kuɗi na atomic ne kuma ba zai taɓa zama ƙasa da sifili ba.
home.marketplace.point3: Farashin haɗin gwiwa, mafi ƙarancin oda da ciniki — kamar kasuwa, amma an lissafa shi.
home.people.title: An gina shi don mutanen da ke gudanar da kasuwanci na gaske.
home.people.body: Daga kanti zuwa kicin zuwa rumfar kasuwa — an yi Kuza don masu aiki da ke sa kasuwancin Afirka ci gaba da tafiya.
home.pricing.title: Farashi mai sauƙi, ka biya bisa amfaninka.
home.pricing.body: Fara kyauta na kwana 14 tare da komai a buɗe. Sannan ka biya kawai don sassan da kake amfani da su. Farashin misali ne kawai.

home.pricing.growth.feat1: Duk abin da ke cikin Starter
home.pricing.growth.feat2: Ƙara Yin fatura, Lissafin kuɗi, Ma'aikata

home.pricing.scale.feat1: Duk abin da ke cikin Growth
home.trust.title: An gina shi kamar kamfanin biyan kuɗi. Domin kuɗinka na nan.
home.trust.body: Kuza tana kula da kowace Naira da tsanantar tsarin kuɗi na kuɗi — ba fatan takardar lissafi ba.
home.trust.item1.title: Babban littafin stok da ba ya canzawa
home.trust.item1.body: Kowace motsin stok layi ne guda da ake ƙarawa kawai — an rubuta shi a cikin ma'amalar bayanai guda da canjin da kansa.
home.trust.item2.title: Biyan kuɗi da aka tabbatar kawai
home.trust.item2.body: Canja wurin banki suna daidaituwa ta hanyar webhooks da aka tabbatar da sa hannu, ba tare da maimaitawa ba. Babu abin da ake sanya alamar an biya bisa hoton allo.
home.trust.item3.title: Tabbatar da biyan kuɗi bisa ƙa'idoji
home.trust.item3.body: Kai ne ke saita sharuɗɗa — adadi, mai biya, kwanan wata. Ana duba kowace motsin kuɗi bisa ƙa'idojinka kuma a bincika shi, tare da jerin gwanon amincewa ga duk abin da ke buƙatar mutum.
home.trust.item4.title: Shiga da ke bin ƙungiyarka
home.trust.item4.body: Izini na kowane reshe, matsayi na musamman, da 2FA kan canje-canjen biyan kuɗi masu mahimmanci.
home.trust.item5.title: Kasuwancinka, keɓe
home.trust.item5.body: Kowane kasuwanci yana rayuwa a cikin nasa tsarin bayanai keɓaɓɓe — bayananka ba sa taɓa raba tebur da na wani.
home.trust.item6.title: Komai a kan rikodi
home.trust.item6.body: Rikodin bincike a duk dandali, da cikakken rikodin ayyuka ga kowace tattaunawar AI da kiran kayan aiki.
home.faq.title: Tambayoyi, an amsa.
home.faq.a1: Tsarin sarrafawa na AI don kasuwanci: ERP guda da ke gudanar da dukkan aikinka — stok, tallace-tallace, kuɗi da ma'aikata — tare da wakilan AI a gaba da ke karɓar oda kuma su duba biyan kuɗi bisa ƙa'idojinka, sannan su shigar da komai cikin littattafanka.
home.faq.q2: Yaya wakilan AI ke sarrafa biyan kuɗi?
home.faq.a2: Kai ne ke saita sharuɗɗa. Ana duba kowace motsin kuɗi bisa ƙa'idojinka (adadi, sunan mai biya, kwanan wata) kuma a bincika shi sosai. A yau waɗannan ayyuka suna shiga jerin gwanon amincewarka kafin komai ya motsa; amincewa ta atomatik bisa ƙa'idoji ga waɗanda suka tsira ita ce hanyar da muke ginawa. Kuɗi kawai yana motsawa ta hanyoyin da ba a maimaitawa, waɗanda aka tabbatar da sa hannu.
home.faq.q3: A waɗanne hanyoyi wakilai za su iya sayarwa?
home.faq.a3: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram da hira ta yanar gizo, ta amfani da ainihin hanyoyin haɗin Meta da Telegram — haka kuma kanti, tebur, famfo da kasuwa.
home.faq.q4: Da gaske komai tsarin rikodi guda ne?
home.faq.a4: Ee. Stok tushe ne da aka raba: sayarwa tana rage shi, lissafin kuɗi yana ganin shi kuma dashboard yana nuna shi — kai tsaye, a cikin ma'amalar bayanai guda, a kowane reshe da hanya.
home.faq.a5: Fara da gwaji kyauta na kwana 14 tare da cikakken shiga. Bayan haka ka biya kawai abin da kake amfani da shi — kowane sashe na sana'a/na gama-gari da amfani — tare da taimakon AI a ciki. Farashin da aka nuna misali ne sai an bayyana in ba haka ba.
home.finalCta.title: Gudanar da komai. Bar Kuza ta sayar a madadinka.
home.finalCta.body: Kwana goma sha huɗu, kowane sashe, cikakken shiga. Sannan ka riƙe kawai abin da kake amfani da shi.
